LanguageData.HypovolemicShock.label: hypovolemic shock
LanguageData.HypovolemicShock.description: Develops above 45% blood loss and can cause acidosis, organ damage and fatal cerebral hypoxia. Stop bleeding and restore blood volume. Good shock tending and adrenaline buy time but do not replace blood; existing complications need separate care.

LanguageData.HypovolemicShock.stages.moderate.label: moderate
LanguageData.HypovolemicShock.stages.severe.label: severe
LanguageData.HypovolemicShock.stages.extreme.label: extreme
